combobox.r0: Complete item collection used for rendering and filtering.
combobox.r1: Controlled or initial selected value; arrays are used with multiple.
combobox.r3: Enables multiple selection and array values.
combobox.r5: Called when the query changes; use it to drive remote search.
combobox.r7: Called when the popup state changes.
combobox.r8: Maps object values to display and search text.
combobox.r9: Maps object values to the value submitted with a form.
combobox.r11: Outer input, trigger, icon, and chip-input size.
combobox.r12: Independent option density in the popup.
combobox.i0: Shows the popup toggle inside the input group.
combobox.i1: Shows a clear action while the combobox has a value.
combobox.i2: Accessible label for the clear action.
combobox.i3: Accessible label for the popup toggle.
combobox.i4: Visual treatment of the input frame.
combobox.i5: Classes applied to the visible InputGroup frame.
combobox.i6: Classes applied to the native input element.
combobox.c2: Distance from and offset along the anchor.
combobox.c3: Custom anchor, required for the chips composition.
combobox.o0: Unique primitive or object value represented by the option.
combobox.o1: Prevents this option from being selected.
combobox.o2: Optional project icon shown before the item content.
combobox.o3: Explicit index for externally virtualized lists.
